results.description:
Sky Force - The Legendary Shoot'em Up Reborn for a New Generation

Sky Force is a modern arcade shoot'em up that brings classic top-down shooter action back to mobile with explosive 3D visuals, satisfying progression, and endless replay value. The skies are burning. Enemy squadrons, towering war machines, and colossal bosses stand between you and victory. Strap into the cockpit, push the throttle, and rediscover one of the most acclaimed airplane games ever made.

A Classic SHMUP Experience, Rebuilt for Modern Players

Inspired by the golden age of vertical arcade shooters, Sky Force 2014 combines fast-paced aerial combat with smooth touch controls, handcrafted enemy waves, and intense bullet-dodging action. Every mission challenges your reflexes, your timing, and your ability to stay calm when the screen fills with fire.

Whether you are a longtime fan of classic shoot'em up games, a bullet hell veteran, or discovering the genre for the first time, Sky Force delivers a polished, accessible, and deeply rewarding arcade experience.

Explosive 3D Action on Mobile

Sky Force takes the classic top-down shooter formula and upgrades it with detailed 3D environments, cinematic explosions, dynamic effects, and beautifully designed battlefields. Fight across oceans, scorched war zones, and storm-filled skies as you blast through enemy forces and push deeper into the campaign.

Every stage is built to feel fast, readable, and satisfying - perfect for quick mobile sessions, but deep enough to keep you coming back for perfect runs. Play online or take the action offline anywhere you go.

Epic Boss Battles That Test Your Skill

Massive flying fortresses. Mechanized war machines. Screen-filling enemies armed with devastating bullet patterns.

Sky Force's boss battles are designed to be both spectacular and demanding. Learn their attacks, dodge incoming fire, strike at the right moment, and prove you have what it takes to become an ace pilot.

Upgrade Your Ship and Master Every Mission

This is more than a one-run arcade shooter. Sky Force rewards persistence, precision, and smart upgrades.

Collect stars, improve your aircraft, and return stronger after every mission. Upgrade your main cannon, side guns, magnets, shields, missiles, and special weapons. Rescue civilians, complete objectives, unlock new difficulty levels, and chase medals as you work toward 100% completion.

Every run matters. Every upgrade brings you closer to building the ultimate fighter.

Built for Replayability

Sky Force is easy to start, but hard to master. Replay missions on higher difficulties, improve your score, perfect your routes, and compete for better results. With multiple objectives, upgrades, medals, tournaments, and leaderboards, every level gives you a reason to return.

Why Players Love Sky Force

- Classic vertical shoot 'em up gameplay reimagined for modern devices
- Intuitive touch controls designed for fast arcade action
- Explosive 3D visuals, cinematic effects, and detailed environments
- Deep aircraft upgrade system with meaningful progression
- Massive bosses and intense bullet hell combat
- Multiple difficulty modes for casual players and hardcore arcade fans
- Missions, medals, tournaments, and leaderboards for long-term replay value
- Retro arcade soul with modern mobile polish
- Plays online or offline, anywhere you go

Take to the Skies

Sky Force is a love letter to classic arcade shooters - fast, explosive, challenging, and endlessly satisfying. It is the airplane game that redefined mobile shoot 'em ups and continues to thrill millions of pilots worldwide.

Download Sky Force free, upgrade your aircraft, and fight your way through one of the most iconic plane shooter experiences ever made.

The war for the skies has begun. The leaderboard is waiting. Take off now.

If you are a true fan of classic arcade shooting games (also known as shoot 'em up / SHMUPs / bullet hell shooters / danmaku / STG), you need to play Sky Champ - one of the best combinations of arcade Shoot 'Em Up & Monster Collecting Games.
This retro arcade shooter is made by Spirit Bomb, an award-winning shooting game developer that produces many classic space shooters and arcade bullet hell shmups (a.k.a. danmaku 弾幕 STG in Japanese). This time Spirit Bomb has come up with a unique shooting experience combining retro arcade shoot 'em up gameplay with monster collecting and RPG elements. Exceed the limit of the shmup genre!

Riding an Okimon (a.k.a Sky Beast) flying along with 2 sidekick monster pets casting chain lightning on fierce enemy invaders is a remarkable shooting experience that can't be found in any other classic space shooters nor airplane shooters. No more lifeless planes and spaceships, you will be immersed with these cute and formidable shooty creatures soaring wings in the seven skies.

Despite being a pick-up-and-play mobile game, Sky Champ has the most depth in the top-down shoot 'em up genre thanks to the RPG-style Elemental Rock-Paper-Scissors system. Sky monsters are divided into 3 elemental types: Fire - Water - Wood and can have elemental advantage against each other. Moreover, each monter has a unique attack move and will gain new elemental abilities when evolved. With these monster attack and skill systems, shooter-holic players can form countless monster squad combinations. This is a superb feature for shooter holic players who also love monster catching and monster collecting games.

*** GAME STORY ***
500 years ago, the fierce dragon beast Typhragon went rage and was about to destroy the earth. An ancient hero defeated the dragon beast and then sealed its spirit in a soulstone. Until one day, the soulstone was stolen by the Phoenix Raiders who then summoned the dragon beast and bred a fierce alien monster army to invade your world. You will train your monster squadron to join the Monster Strikers Force and strike back against the alien invaders.

*** FEATURES ***
- Unique retro arcade shmup brings back nostalgia of top-down arcade shooters and Japanese bullet hell shooters from your childhood.
- Adventure Mode with 100 Levels will unfold the story of the Monster Strikers Force against the Phoenix Raiders
- Procedurally generated Arcade Shmup Mode. Each flight is distinct
- Lightning fast shooty experience with Dynamic Difficulty Balancing
- Many top-down shooting game modes to challenge your skills of shooting monsters, dodging bullet waves and fighting bosses.
- Collecting 100+ formidable flying monster pets and Sky Beasts with distinct attacks and crowd control skills. Use them tactically against the enemy monster invaders to gain advantage. Are you a monster-holic?
- Monster evolution: like in best monster catching and collecting games, transform your monsters, unlock new abilities and exceed level caps!
- Distinct Power-Ups including thunder strike missiles, falcon ice blasts, phoenix revive, lightning bombs, thunder blazes
- Catching and Collecting legendary sky monster pets
- 100+ equipment e.g. radiant falcon swords, thunder phoenix ring, elemental wing sabre, barrage shield will exceed your monsters' limits.
- Hundreds of fierce enemy creatures and sky monster bosses with distinct elemental wings. Learn the invaders' strike patterns to take them down!
- Online multi-player Sky League: test your monster squads against other monster trainers'.
- Hatching monster eggs
- Pick-up-and-play with simple one-handed controls and configurable sensitivity. Dodging bullet waves and shooting alien monsters have never felt so fun!
- Best of both worlds: combining retro shooting experience of best arcade shooters with depth and strategy of best monster catching and monster collecting games. Brings back the arcade nostalgia from your childhood

Remember the feeling of weaving through enemy fire, upgrading your fighter, and unleashing chaos in the skies? 1945 Air Force brings that arcade adrenaline rush back – now with a modern edge and over 900 explosive levels.

**CLASSIC ARCADE SHOOTING, COMPLETELY REIMAGINED**
*1945 Air Force* combines the nostalgic feel of classic arcade shooting games with modern visuals and smooth controls, delivering a more immersive and polished combat experience. With intuitive gameplay and action-packed battles, anyone can easily enjoy fast-paced, satisfying shooting fun.

**CONQUER OVER 900 LEVELS OF WWII AIR COMBAT**  
Fly across authentic battlefields, from Europe to the Pacific. Each mission brings new enemy waves, screen-filling bosses, and thrilling challenges to overcome. Your reflexes will be pushed to the limit.

**UNLOCK AND UPGRADE LEGENDARY WARPLANES**  
Take control of 60+ iconic aircraft from the UK, USA, Germany, Japan, and the USSR. Each plane comes with unique strengths. Upgrade weapons, shields, and special abilities to build your ultimate flying machine.

**TEST YOUR SKILLS IN REAL-TIME PVP**  
Engage in fast-paced dogfights with players from around the world. Climb the global leaderboards and prove yourself as a top ace pilot.

**FORM CLANS AND FIGHT TOGETHER**  
Join a squadron or create your own. Take on exclusive team events, earn powerful rewards, and rise together through cooperative gameplay.

**PLAY ANYTIME – ONLINE OR OFFLINE**  
No connection? No problem. With offline support, daily rewards, limited-time events, and varied game modes, there’s always a reason to return to the skies.

**KEY FEATURES:**  
- 900+ handcrafted campaign levels based on real WWII battles  
- 60+ legendary aircraft to unlock, upgrade, and master  
- Real-time PvP battles with global matchmaking  
- Massive boss fights and classic bullet-hell gameplay  
- Clan system with team missions and exclusive rewards  
- Multiple modes: Campaign, PvP, Boss, Events  
- Offline gameplay support  

Download 1945 Air Force today and take to the skies in the most thrilling arcade shooter on mobile.

Metalstorm is an online competitive shooter where matches are decided by skill, positioning, and team coordination. Jump into real-time multiplayer battles against real players, master distinct combat roles and jets, and compete in fast-paced air combat built for serious PvP players. Played by millions of players worldwide, Metalstorm delivers modern warfare for competitive shooter fans.


Master your role, win the fight, and climb toward ace status.




COMPETITIVE 5V5 MULTIPLAYER COMBAT
Metalstorm is built for skill-based PvP and team coordination.

- Online 5v5 Battles: Fight with your squad in real-time multiplayer modes like Team Deathmatch, Air Superiority, and Elimination
- Fast Matchmaking: Jump into quick 6-minute matches with real players in seconds.
- Global Rankings: Climb the global leaderboards and prove your status as a legendary ace in our PvP modes
- Team-Based Air Combat: Master your guns and own the sky in a game built for action, not simulation


DISTINCT COMBAT ROLES & JET ABILITIES
Every aircraft in Metalstorm fills a unique combat role. Choose your playstyle and adapt your strategy with 5 distinct class roles and over 42 authentic jets to choose from like: 

- Frontline Tank (A-10 Thunderbolt): Tank damage and dominate close-range combat with iconic guns
- Stealth Assassin (JAS39 Gripen): Ambush enemies with precision strikes and vanish
- Recon Scout (F-35 Lightning): Provide overwatch for your team with battlefield intel
- Sharpshoot Sniper (F-14 Tomcat): Control airspace with multi-lock missile systems
- Tactical Support (Rafale): Disrupt enemy targeting with advanced electronic warfare


BUILD, UPGRADE, AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR ARSENAL
Progress through a deep upgrade system designed for long-term mastery and competitive balance. Modify your fleet like a real warfare strategist to fit the needs of your multiplayer team:

- Jet Stats: Upgrade speed, durability, and guns across 20 levels
- Mods: Customize jets with damage resistance, gun boosts, and high-skill maneuvering upgrades
- Unique Ability: Unlock powerful ultimate abilities that can change the course of battle
- Licensed Aircraft: Fly officially licensed aircraft from Lockheed Martin, Boeing, and Northrop Grumman, including the F-16 Fighting Falcon, F-22 Raptor, F/A-18 Super Hornet, and F-14 Tomcat


LIVE EVENTS, SEASONS & REGULAR UPDATES
The action never stops. Metalstorm is a live multiplayer game with constant new content and limited-time challenges.

- Seasonal Battle Pass: Complete missions to unlock customizations and upgrade resources
- Weekly & Limited-Time Events: Experience rotating game modes and special challenges

- Black Market: Prepare for new jet releases with squad-based challenges and event rewards


SQUAD UP WITH FRIENDS
Join a Squadron of warriors and compete together in the most social online multiplayer game on mobile. Chat strategy with teammates and climb the Squadron Leaderboards together. Whether you’re a casual action fan or a hardcore competitive shooter, Metalstorm offers a social multiplayer experience built around teamwork and progression.


EPIC MAPS & OPTIMIZED PERFORMANCE
Battle across dynamic maps designed for tactical air combat. Use terrain, cover, and altitude to outplay opponents across environments like icy arctic battlefields and high-risk nuclear facilities. Enjoy high-definition visuals and smooth performance optimized for mobile devices.


Download Metalstorm: Modern Air Combat now and experience one of the most competitive online jet PvP shooters. Jump in the cockpit and earn your place among the world’s top aces.

ARE YOU READY FOR AIR ATTACK???


With 4.3 stars rating and over 2M users, Gunship Battle Helicopter UK is the best shooting game you are going to find!

Welcome to world war 2.
Rivals forces are threatening to invade the country from the sea and take over the shoreline. Warships and helicopters are getting closer and closer to land, putting the nation into real danger. The stakes are getting higher with every passing second!

You are a frontline air force special commando forces heli pilot. Your mission is to stop the invaders by targeting them, fire bombs and shoot them down from the air. 
Will you be able to navigate the heli well enough? How well will you target the warship? Will you fire the RPG on time? Are you REALLY fit for the air force?

***There is not much time! Download Gunship Battle Helicopter UK NOW and become the hero of world war 2!!!***


HOW TO PLAY?
1. Control the helicopter by tilting your phone
2. Navigate the heli and get closer to your enemies shown on the radar
3. Target the enemy
4. Attack everything that moves: kill your rivals - shoot machine gun, RPG missiles and bombs 
5. Sink ships, gun boats, and other enemy apache & chopper helicopters to pass levels
6. Be careful! Your rivals can fire back! Do your best to escape their attacks 

***Are you ready to be the new nation’s hero??? Download Gunship Battle Helicopter UK NOW and let’s see what you’ve got!!!***
